scope: Bounded comparative test-host experiment; not statistical reliability or universal Android root-cause qualification
referenceScope: Exact observed image and kernel MemTotal from retained run40076857612; drift makes the comparison inconclusive without changing resources
sampling: Identical existing bounded optional-capability probe in both arms; unavailable PSI and probe timeouts remain explicit
workload: One original adapter invocation per trial, both original cold recovery witnesses when adapter checks pass, and one independent cross-UID clipboard invocation; all failure/NOT RUN states retained
qualification: Never replace original qualification exit codes or assertions; no fallback or retry
exitCriteria: Both adapter/probe and clipboard commands must exit zero without timeout, plus all complete original receipts
targetBinding: A control LMK must match one actual target PID/start event, an observed target process after that birth and before its kill, and the captured device instrumentation time window; missing or ambiguous identity is inconclusive
mechanismFinding: Both controls must reproduce startup LMK, both treatments must pass the entire declared workload and same-process/ordinary-cold-launch guards; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
cleanup: Stop only the captured owned emulator; delete only its fresh generated AVD after retaining configuration and receipts; abort if ownership or cleanup is uncertain
